resume: Single analog synth laid out like the microKORG: two oscillators, five filters, two envelopes, two LFOs, a patch bay, an arpeggiator and a 16-step sequencer. Each page draws what it adjusts.

commandes.role: Keyboard octave down; both OCT buttons held 5 s: update mode.
Keyboard octave up; both OCT buttons held 5 s: update mode.
FILTER, KEY TRACK, SCALE, CHORD pages (SCL in the docs); pressing again moves to the next.
FILTER EG and AMP EG envelopes.
LFO 1, LFO 2 and patch bay (PATCH 1 to 4).
OSC 1, OSC 2, MIXER and SUB/DRIFT oscillators; pressing again moves to the next page.
PERFORM: cutoff, resonance, EG int, LFO 1 speed.
Writes the program: PRESETS picks the slot, KNOB 1 the letter, KNOB 2 changes it, SAVE writes, HOME cancels.
Turns the arpeggiator on or off.
Steps through all the pages, one by one.
Picks the program (it loads as you turn; unwritten changes are lost).
Sets the cutoff, from any page.

a_savoir: To recover the device after a bad boot: power on while holding OCT-, which starts USB rescue.
